summary.id: Fondasi tampilan baru, diuji di Dashboard Super & Admin: font Geist, skala tulisan tanpa tebal, tema gelap lebih pekat, persentase metrik sebaris.
summary.en: New look foundation, trialled on the Super & Admin dashboards: Geist font, weight-light type scale, deeper dark theme, inline metric percentages.

detail.id: 7 ukuran (12–40) dengan berat 400/500 saja; penekanan lewat ukuran & warna. Font 18 KB. Baru di Dashboard.
detail.en: 7 sizes (12–40), weights 400/500 only; emphasis through size and colour. 18 KB font. Dashboard only for now.

detail.id: Latar #0A0A0B, kartu #141415 bertepi tipis — berlaku di seluruh halaman tema gelap.
detail.en: Background #0A0A0B, cards #141415 with a hairline border — applies to every dark-theme page.

detail.id: +12% ↗ hijau, −8,1% ↘ merah, 0% → abu-abu; keterangan periode tetap di bawah.
detail.en: +12% ↗ green, −8.1% ↘ red, 0% → grey; the period caption stays below.

summary.id: Preview lebih ringan: berkas besar dimuat belakangan.
summary.en: Lighter preview: large files load later.

detail.id: Data bank/wilayah dan pembuat PDF kontrak (1,4 MB) diunduh setelah tampilan muncul; tampil ±15% lebih cepat di jaringan HP.
detail.en: Bank/region data and the contract PDF maker (1.4 MB) download after the screen appears; about 15% faster on mobile networks.

summary.id: Titik awal v1.1: audit keamanan & uang, ikon verifikasi baru, data contoh disamarkan.
summary.en: v1.1 starting point: security & money audit, new verification badge, pseudonymised sample data.

detail.id: Bintang datar 11 ujung sesuai referensi; centang transparan mengikuti warna latar.
detail.en: Flat 11-point star per the reference; the check is transparent and shows the background.

detail.id: Nama label, artis, email, WA dan alamat asli diganti samaran; nominal dan status tetap.
detail.en: Real label, artist, email, phone and address values are replaced; amounts and statuses are kept.

title.en: Preview opens without the version run-through

detail.id: Tampilan muncul sekali dalam kondisi akhir; label versi kini v1.1 · dev N.
detail.en: The screen appears once in its final state; the version label is now v1.1 · dev N.

title.id: Pembayaran token tidak lagi melunasi add-on
title.en: Token payments no longer settle add-ons

detail.id: Invoice berisi add-on dibayar rupiah; token hanya untuk biaya rilisan.
detail.en: Invoices with add-ons are paid in rupiah; tokens cover the release fee only.

detail.id: Klik ganda tidak memotong token dua kali, tidak ada refund ganda, withdraw yang sudah dibayar tidak bisa ditolak ulang.
detail.en: Double clicks never spend twice, no double refunds, paid withdrawals cannot be rejected again.

detail.id: Keluar akun berfungsi saat pratinjau; menu khusus Super Admin tersembunyi selama pratinjau.
detail.en: Sign-out works during preview; Super Admin-only menus stay hidden while previewing.
